text.Die meisten Google Ads Accounts verliere: Most Google Ads accounts lose budget every day to search terms that will never convert: job seekers, competitors, irrelevant queries. Reviewing them by hand takes time and quickly gets out of hand.
text.Der Fetcher holt täglich deine aktuellen: Every day the Fetcher pulls your latest search terms into a Google Sheet. The Analyzer sends them to an AI that classifies each term based on your industry, your business and your conversion data.
text.Jeder Begriff bekommt eine Klassifizieru: Every term gets a classification, a confidence score and a one-sentence reason. You review, correct where needed and push the negatives back into your account with one click.

text.So sieht das Tabellenblatt „SearchTerms“: This is what the “SearchTerms” tab looks like. In your sheet it shows your real data.

text.Läuft täglich. Holt alle Suchbegriffe au: Runs daily. Pulls every search term from your Search campaigns, removes duplicates and adds up clicks and conversions over 30 days. Writes everything to the sheet.
text.Schickt die Suchbegriffe in Paketen an d: Sends the search terms to the AI in batches. Each term comes back with a classification, a confidence score and a plain-language reason. You define your industry once.
text.Vier Tabellenblätter: SearchTerms ist de: Four tabs: SearchTerms is your working surface, Config is the only thing you adjust per account, Negative_Export holds the validated negatives, and Expansion_Ideas collects terms worth building campaigns around.
